event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
1:01 p.m. Weather conditions: air temperature 77 degrees, relative humidity 56 percent, barometer 30.10 inches, adjusted altitude 2,560 feet, track temperature 115 degrees.

Hagan is 15 - 2 against Lee in prior events. 

They leave the line together but Hagan starts pulling away and extends his lead all the way through the run. Lee makes a decent pass.

Matt Hagan's incremental margins: 60ft(0.016), 330 ft(0.026), 660ft(0.035).  MOV: 0.0483 seconds (approximately 23 feet).

Matt Hagan's incremental times: 60ft-0.889 sec., 330ft-2.281, 660ft-3.218/278.12 mph.

Paul Lee's incremental times: 60ft-0.905 sec., 330ft-2.307, 660ft-3.253/274.89 mph.

Capps is 9 - 3 against Wilkerson in prior events. 

Wilkerson hits the throttle and goes up in smoke. He gets back on the throttle, then gives up on the run. Capps goes down the groove with a good pass to take the win.

Capps will give up lane choice to Hagan in the next round with the points lead on the line.

Beckman is 19 - 6 against DeJoria in prior events. 

Beckman goes down the groove with another good run to take the win. DeJoria gets about 400 feet out and strikes the tires.

Vandergriff is 3 - 2 against Prock in prior events. 

Prock gets off of the line first, starts pulling away, and extends his lead all the way through the run.

Beckman will have lane choice over Prock in the next round.

With Vandergriff's loss, the race between Capps and Hagan in the next round will determine the regular season championship.
